items.goal: Prepare the existing catalogue offer for the first real eligible inbound case using the documented administrative CAD collection route. If accepted terms or authorization are missing, produce a copy-ready nonbinding clarification and state exactly what must be evidenced before an operator can create or accept a paid order. A real eligible request, operator-approved terms and administrative acceptance are required before any paid order. Do not send externally, create an order, issue payment instructions, access private mail, spend or deploy. Complete under valid ownership with evidence and a lesson. Any eventual public release requires host-enforced independent review.
